title: Work Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the work done during the expansion from A to B as W = 1.0 x 10^5 J.

title: Internal Energy Change
description: Essential Criteria: The student must accurately determine the change in internal energy as Delta U = 1.5 x 10^5 J.

title: Heat Absorption
description: Essential Criteria: The student must compute the heat absorbed during the process as Q = 2.5 x 10^5 J.

title: Adiabatic Pressure
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive the final pressure after the adiabatic process as p_C = 1.24 x 10^5 N/m^2.

title: Entropy Change
description: Important Criteria: The student must show that the entropy change during the adiabatic process is Delta S = 0.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign errors in calculations, particularly in work and heat transfer.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should be cautious of missing factors in the equations for work, internal energy, or heat.
